Invite: "Redwood — Aurora HealthTech: platform demo" (Google Meet link included).

Note: I had to forward the invite through our scheduling system (external calendar tool). If your calendar admin forwards invites between orgs, sometimes Google marks the event as "floating" (no explicit timezone) and recipients in some locales see a shifted hour/day. If anyone sees a slot at 03:00 (3am) instead of 15:00, that's usually a floating/ICS anchor issue — not an intentional change.

I'll attach the ICS file I exported. If the APAC team needs a separate local-time invite, I can create one for their timezone.
